# APPROACH 1C: STAGGARD EVENT STUDY MODELS 
```{r}
# Step 1. Create event_time variable for all treated countries (NA for never-treated)
panel_es <- panel %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(as.character(year))) %>%
  group_by(country_code) %>%
  mutate(
    # Fill the episode start year for ALL rows of treated countries
    aut_start_filled = min(aut_ep_start_yr[aut_ep == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    aut_start_filled = ifelse(is.infinite(aut_start_filled), NA_real_, aut_start_filled),
    
    # Event time for all years of treated countries, NA for never-treated
    event_time = year - aut_start_filled) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2. Capped event_time indicators 
panel_es <- panel_es %>%
  mutate(
    treated = ifelse(!is.na(event_time), 1, 0),
    event_time_cap = case_when(
      treated == 1 & event_time < -4 ~ -4,
      treated == 1 & event_time > 5 ~ 5,
      treated == 1 ~ event_time,
      TRUE ~ 0)) # never-treated

# Step 3: TWFE with binned event time indicators (overall SDG missingness)
es_twfe <- feols(
  prop_sdg_missing 
  ~ i(event_time_cap, treated, ref = -1)
  + log_pop
  + electric_access + I(electric_access^2)
  + log_luminosity
  + rural_pop_pct
  | country_code + year,
  cluster = ~country_code,
  data = panel_es)

summary(es_twfe)

# Step 4: Event-study plot (overall SDG missingness)
iplot(
  es_twfe,
  main = "Event-study: SDG missingness around autocratization",
  xlab = "Years since start of autocratization (event_time)",
  ylab = "Change in prop_sdg_missing vs t = -1"
)
```

```{r}
# Step 5. Event-study plot with SPI interaction (overall SDG missingness)
es_twfe_x_income <- feols(
  prop_sdg_missing 
  ~ i(event_time_cap, treated, ref = -1) * factor(income_level)
  + log_pop
  + electric_access + I(electric_access^2)
  + log_luminosity
  + rural_pop_pct
  | country_code + year,
  cluster = ~country_code,
  data = panel_es)

summary(es_twfe_x_income)

# Step 6: Event-study plot with SPI interaction (overall SDG missingness)
iplot(
  es_twfe_x_income,
  main = "Event-study: SDG missingness around autocratization, by SPI",
  xlab = "Years since start of autocratization (event_time)",
  ylab = "Change in prop_sdg_missing vs t = -1, by SPI"
)

# Subsets by Income Group 
es_twfe_income_group <- feols(
  prop_sdg_missing ~ 
    i(event_time_cap, treated, ref = -1) +
    log_pop + electric_access + I(electric_access^2) +
    log_luminosity + rural_pop_pct |
    country_code + year,
  cluster = ~country_code,
  data = panel_es[panel_es$income_level == "H", ]
)
summary(es_twfe_income_group)

# plot for High Income group
iplot(
  es_twfe_income_group,
  main = "Event-study: SDG missingness around autocratization (High Income group)",
  xlab = "Years since start of autocratization (event_time)",
  ylab = "Change in prop_sdg_missing vs t = -1"
)
```


## Goal-level TWFE models (with lags)
```{r}
# Step 7: Goal-level TWFE with binned event time indicators (example for SDG1 missingness)

# A. Pick the SDG goal
sdg_goal <- "prop_miss_SDG3"   # e.g. SDG1; change this string for other goals

# B. Create a generic outcome column
panel_es$Y_goal <- panel_es[[sdg_goal]]

# C. Run the model using Y_goal in a normal formula
es_twfe_x_income_g <- feols(
  Y_goal 
  ~ i(event_time_cap, treated, ref = -1) * factor(income_level)
    + log_pop
    + electric_access + I(electric_access^2)
    + log_luminosity
    + rural_pop_pct
  | country_code + year,
  cluster = ~country_code,
  data = panel_es
)

summary(es_twfe_x_income_g)

# plot
iplot(
  es_twfe_x_income_g,
  main = paste0("Event-study: ", sdg_goal, " missingness around autocratization, by Income Level"),
  xlab = "Years since start of autocratization (event_time)",
  ylab = paste0("Change in ", sdg_goal, " vs t = -1, by Income Level")
)

# =============================================================================
# D. Run the model using Y_goal in a normal formula
es_twfe_income_group_g <- feols(
  Y_goal 
  ~ i(event_time_cap, treated, ref = -1)
    + log_pop
    + electric_access + I(electric_access^2)
    + log_luminosity
    + rural_pop_pct
  | country_code + year,
  cluster = ~country_code,
  data = panel_es[panel_es$income_level == "H", ]
)

summary(es_twfe_income_group_g)

# plot
iplot(
  es_twfe_income_group_g,
  main = paste0("Event-study: ", sdg_goal, " missingness around autocratization (High Income group)"),
  xlab = "Years since start of autocratization (event_time)",
  ylab = paste0("Change in ", sdg_goal, " vs t = -1")
)
```


```{r}
# saving panel_es as csv
write_csv(panel_es, "data/output/panel_es_data.csv")
```
